_notice: REAL, NAMED restaurants. Every name, address, cuisine, and review-count figure below is a public fact pulled from search results and cited by source URL. What this is NOT: a full Public Trust Score. Star-rating sentiment, review-authenticity, reservation-demand, and freshness data are NOT included here because Yelp and Tripadvisor block automated fetching of their pages (robots.txt) and no licensed API is connected yet (see docs/source-policy/approved-sources.md). Getting real, safe-to-publish scores for real businesses requires either manual verification against the source pages (someone reading the actual page and confirming the number) or a licensed API like Google Places. Publishing a full 50-100 'trust score' for a real business on anything less than that is a defamation risk this file deliberately avoids. Coordinates are neighborhood-center approximations, not geocoded street addresses -- see field note on each entry. Expanded 2026-09-01 from 7 to 139 restaurants via services/agents/source-ingestion-agent/discover-restaurants.mjs (Google Places Nearby Search across a grid covering Scottsdale), reviewed by hand: excluded non-restaurant categories that Google's 'restaurant' type also returns (gas stations, liquor stores, malls, golf clubs, hotels/resorts as such, coffee-only shops) and excluded results whose address is outside Scottsdale, AZ (a few Places near the Scottsdale/Phoenix border share a Phoenix, AZ 85054 mailing address despite the name). Newly added entries carry a pre-resolved place_id (saves a redundant Google Places lookup on the first run) and lack a website field -- siteFreshness stays an honest 'no website URL on file' for them until one is added, same as for several of the original 7.
